title: A save that got no answer and is later refused freezes the desk until the page is reloaded
what: When a non-money save gets no answer it is kept to be sent again before the next action. If the gym is then paused, its plan lapses, or the person loses owner rights, the resend is refused, but that refusal is not treated as final: the save stays kept, every later action on the desk fails with the same refusal, and the background refresh hides the error. The first-try path already treats these refusals as final; the resend path was missed, and no test covers it.
expected: A final refusal on the resend drops the kept save (or moves it to the waiting list) and tells the desk once, as the first-try path already does.
how_often: rarely: a save with no answer, then a pause, lapsed plan or lost rights
fix_line: Apply the same final-refusal rule to the resend, and add a test for it

title: Sign-in code keeps a few unused helpers and a copied storage check
what: A WhatsApp yes/no helper, a device-name helper (its own note says it is shown nowhere) and a privacy page link are never used by any screen or test. The safe check for whether browser storage is allowed is written twice, in two files.
expected: Unused helpers removed and the storage check kept in one place.
fix_line: Delete the three unused helpers and share one storage check

title: Sign-in screens show times by two different rules
what: The PIN-locked time on Staff & sign-in uses the device clock zone in 12-hour style (5:40 pm), while the MettleUp access card uses India time in 24-hour style (17:40). On a device set to another zone the lock time is off from India time, and the two styles sit side by side.
expected: One time rule (India time, one style) for every time on these screens.
fix_line: Use the India-time helper for the PIN lock time too
